    Benefits of Prefab

    time-effectiveness

    Approximately 70–80% of the work is completed in our factory, reducing the work required at site. The extent of factory completion depends on the selected design and project scope. Production begins after the required foundations are ready, and manufacturing, transportation and installation are planned as separate stages.

    cost-effectiveness

    Factory production helps coordinate materials, labour and quality checks before installation. Standardised designs provide a clear starting point for comparing options and planning your budget. Your project quotation identifies the selected cottage, inclusions, optional items and site responsibilities, with GST and transportation quoted separately.

    flexibility

    Choose from single-room cottages, studios, family homes and multi-room hospitality designs to suit your project. Layout and finish options depend on the selected model and technical feasibility. If future relocation is a requirement, discuss it during planning so the structure, connections and site arrangements can be reviewed accordingly.

    ​quality

    Our factory-based process allows structural components, materials and finishes to be checked before dispatch. Site preparation and installation are coordinated with the approved drawings and agreed scope. Structural requirements and project specifications are reviewed for the selected design and site conditions.

    sustainability

    Factory-based production supports planned material use and organised handling of construction waste. Completing more work before dispatch also reduces fabrication activities at the project site. Material selection, durability and regular maintenance remain important throughout the life of the cottage.

    risk reduction

    Completing a substantial portion of the work in the factory reduces the number of construction activities required at site. Delivery and installation still need careful planning, including suitable access, unloading space, foundation readiness and safe working arrangements. These requirements are reviewed as part of the project scope.

    Modular Technology

    BUILDING SYSTEMS

    ​

    LOOM CRAFTS uses the best dry technologies, already tested and available on the market, to design modular buildings with standard components. The structural components of the floor, wall and roof are totally prefabricated  by Loom Crafts as we are experts in the processing, with numerically controlled machines, and assembly of the materials.

    THE BUILDING’S CONFIGURATION

    ​

    Loom Crafts offers a range of standardised modular home and cottage designs. Layout and finish options depend on the selected model and technical feasibility. Our team reviews your requirements and confirms the available options, specifications and scope before production.

    PRODUCT DISTRIBUTION

    ​

    Factory-manufactured components are transported to the project site and assembled according to approved drawings and the agreed installation scope. Delivery and installation are coordinated around foundation readiness, site access, unloading arrangements and safe working conditions.

    About Us

    Loom Crafts designs and manufactures prefab homes, modular villas and hospitality cottages for projects across India. Established in 2005, we offer designs for farmhouses, holiday homes, resorts and glamping projects, with layouts and specifications tailored to the selected model and agreed scope.

    ​

    Catalogue starting prices range from ₹18.5–36 lakh for 1BHK homes and ₹30.5–61 lakh for 2BHK homes. The 3BHK range starts at ₹51.5 lakh and extends to ₹1.21 crore, while 4BHK designs range from ₹85 lakh to ₹1.27 crore. Single-room cottages start at ₹9 lakh and studio cottages at ₹13.5 lakh. GST and transport are extra. Final pricing depends on the model, variant, finishes and project requirements.

    ​

    Typically, 70–80% of the work is completed in the factory, depending on the model and scope. Production begins after foundations are ready. Our team confirms production, transport and installation schedules in the quotation, together with the included work and any additional site costs.

    ​

    Explore the available designs and completed projects, or share your location and requirements with our team for a project-specific quotation.

    Frequently asked questions

    How much do Loom Crafts prefab homes cost?

    Catalogue starting prices range from ₹18.5–36 lakh for 1BHK homes, ₹30.5–61 lakh for 2BHK homes, ₹51.5 lakh–₹1.21 crore for 3BHK homes and ₹85 lakh–₹1.27 crore for 4BHK homes. Single-room cottages start at ₹9 lakh and studio cottages at ₹13.5 lakh. GST and transport are extra. Your quotation confirms the price for the selected model, variant and project scope.

    What is included in the starting price?

    The starting price relates to the selected model and its stated specification. Your quotation confirms the included structure, finishes, fittings and installation scope, together with exclusions.


    Foundations, site preparation, utility connections, access equipment and optional items should be checked separately before ordering.

    How long does production and installation take?

    Timelines depend on the model, approved scope and site readiness. Production begins after foundations are ready. The quotation confirms production, transport and installation schedules; a production duration should not be treated as the complete delivery timeline.

    Can I use a prefab cottage for a farmhouse, holiday home or resort?

    Loom Crafts offers models for residential and hospitality projects, including farmhouses, holiday homes, resorts and glamping accommodation. Share the intended use, location and number of units so our team can help you compare suitable designs and project requirements.

    Can the layout or finishes be changed?

    Layout and finish changes can be reviewed for the selected model. Feasibility, specification, price and any effect on the schedule are confirmed before the order is finalised.

    What foundations and site access are needed?

    Foundation and access requirements depend on the model and site. Share the site location, photographs and available access details with our team. The foundation scope and arrangements for transport, unloading, installation and utilities must be confirmed before production begins.

    Who checks local permissions?

    Discuss land use and any required permissions with the relevant local authority or a qualified local professional before ordering. Do not assume that a prefab or relocatable structure is automatically exempt. Our team can discuss the selected model's technical information for your project review.

    What warranty is offered?

    Loom Crafts offers a 20-year warranty on structure and rain leakage, subject to the written warranty terms and exclusions. Ask for the applicable warranty and care information for the selected model, finishes, fittings and components with your quotation.

    How do I request a quotation?

    Send us your project location, preferred model or room configuration, intended use and number of units. You can also share your budget, site photographs and preferred schedule. Our team will discuss the requirements and prepare a quotation for the agreed scope.
